newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arson guts asylum-seekers home in Germany, 21 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Arson guts asylum-seekers home in Germany, 21 hurt.

text.p: Arsonists set fire to an asylum-seekers' home in the western city of Essen early on Monday and 21 of about 100 residents were injured in the blaze, German police said.
Police said they were investigating a case of serious arson, but had found no indications of a racist attack.
Several residents panicked and jumped out of windows from the four-storey building, injuring themselves, they said.
Firefighters rescued about 39 people using ladders before the building was gutted by the blaze.

Police said only 57 asylum-seekers were officially registered in the home although they estimated about 100 to be living there at the time of the blaze. German radio reported that most of them were refugees from Africa.
